title: Reproducibility archive for two agricultural-tractor virtual-prototype studies
description:
Published Machines and Energies articles, clean model and algorithm source, experiment-generation scripts, declared parameter manifests, figures, and documentation for two theoretical agricultural-tractor virtual-prototype studies.

The working tree contains no frozen experiment outputs, trajectories, checkpoints, review correspondence, publication certificates, or submission packages. Main experiments can be recomputed from source in an empty external workspace; this archive does not claim to provide the complete frozen-data deposit.

There are no vehicle, bench, or target-component calibration data. The approximately 20% fuel case uses ideal conditions, complete future information, and a wider terminal-SOC band and is separate from the causal online protocol. Article DOIs are 10.3390/machines14111248 and 10.3390/en19215024.
